==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|pœnalty||archaic}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*kʷey-|id=pay}}
{{etymon|en|id=punishment|:bor|frm:pénalité<id:penalty>|tree=0}}
From {{bor|en|frm|pénalité}}, from {{m|frm|pénal}}, from {{der|en|la|poenālis}}, from {{m|la|poena}}, borrowing of {{der|en|grc|ποινή}}, from {{der|en|grk-pro|*kʷoinā́}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*kʷoynéh₂}}, comprising {{m|ine-pro|*kʷey-|id=pay}} + {{m|ine-pro|*-nós|*-néh₂}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɛn.əl.ti/}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-penalty.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{hyph|en|pen|al|ty}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[legal]] [[sentence]].
#: {{ux|en|The '''penalty''' for his crime was to do hard labor.}}
# A [[punishment]] for violating rules of procedure.
#: {{syn|en|punishment|punition|sentence|Thesaurus:penalty}}
#* {{RQ:Chesnutt House Behind the Cedars|I|passage=Was it so irreconcilable, Warwick wondered, as still to peal out the curfew bell, which at nine o'clock at night had clamorously warned all negroes, slave or free, that it was unlawful for them to be abroad after that hour, under '''penalty''' of imprisonment or whipping?}}
# {{lb|en|finance}} A [[payment]] [[forfeit]]ed for an early withdrawal from an account or an investment.
# ''In sports:''
## {{lb|en|football}} A direct [[free kick]] from the [[penalty spot]], taken after a defensive foul in the [[penalty box]]; a [[penalty kick]].
## {{lb|en|ice hockey}} A punishment for an infraction of the rules, often in the form of being removed from play for a specified amount of time.
##: {{ux|en|A '''penalty''' was called when he tripped up his opponent.}}
# A [[disadvantageous]] [[consequence]] of a previous event.
#* {{RQ:Landon Francesca Carrara|page=126|volume=III|text="But you, my noble, my generous girl!" exclaimed Lord Avonleigh, "I dare not let you pay the '''penalty''' of my former folly."}}
